name: Arlington Independent School District
districtFact: Arlington ISD publishes school-year calendars for districtwide dates and may provide separate calendars for grade levels or programs, including A/B and Early College High School schedules.

about.title: Using the Arlington ISD Calendar
about.content: Use the school-year calendar page for district holidays and major breaks, then open any grade-level or program calendar that applies to the student. Campus announcements remain the source for dismissal times, testing, athletics, graduation and same-day changes.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Arlington ISD Families
content: Check whether your student follows the elementary, secondary, A/B, or Early College High School calendar before making final plans.
Check parent-conference and early-dismissal dates before arranging pickup or after-school care.
Treat bad weather make-up days as conditional planning dates until Arlington ISD confirms whether missed instructional time must be recovered.
Use Arlington ISD and campus announcements for revisions, emergency closures and same-day changes.

comparisonTitle: Arlington ISD Calendar Compared With Nearby Districts
compareIntro: Compare the Arlington ISD calendar with other Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas district calendars currently available on MySchoolDates. Dates shown include the first day, last day, and spring break.
